verdict.rationale: Supabase's own documented Advisors ship with the platform and inspect the live schema, returning findings such as missing indexes. That covers the index-recommendation part of the story. Nothing in the pack shows a slow-query view or performance metrics in a built-in insights surface. Logs only covers inspecting service events, not performance. Missing for 10: slow-query identification, performance metrics dashboard, a documented unified insights view, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can see slow queries, index recommendations, and performance metrics in a built-in insights view

citations.quote: Advisors are programmatic checks that ship with the platform. They inspect the live schema and return deterministic findings, such as missing indexes or incorrectly configured RLS policies.
